# ledger_labels (Data Source)

Lists Ledger labels, optionally filtered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ledger_labels" "active" {
  archived    = false
  name_prefix = "re"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Only archived (`true`) or only active (`false`) ones. Both are listed when unset.
- `name_prefix` (String) Only names starting with this text, ignoring case.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching labels, in creation order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether it is archived.
- `archived_at` (String) When it was archived (RFC 3339, UTC), or null.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (String) The Ledger identifier.
- `name` (String) The name.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `version` (Number) The optimistic-concurrency version.
